entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, rose 27 centimetres in a day to 89 centimetres on 18 November
entry.summary: The 06:15 reading is 27 centimetres above the same hour on 17 November and 84 above the 5 centimetre low of 8 November. The gauge rose through 17 November, from 61 to 77 centimetres. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, Kaub readings of 16, 17 and 18 November 2026
